title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What do you think of the Mets hiring Brodie Van Wagonen as GM?
Didn’t watch the press conference but just listened to his interview with Francesa... sounds exactly like Menzin
Pretty impossible for me to say considering I know nothing about him, but I’m optimistic
B+ for an expedient answer. I didn’t expect any less.
I think it’s so Mets. Clown show. I’m a curmudgeon, though.
Don’t like the precedent set with hiring an agent, nor the basis of passing up more qualified, baseball guys:
On the same hand, think he’s got enough baseball knowledge to succeed. It’s not rocket science.
